author: Zephyr V
title: CPS_v4 XL Post-Deep Shallow v3 - Timed Consolidated Write (CPU, 16KB)
abstract: Third post-deep shallow consolidated write, timing op_cost_ms, notes "XL:shallow_post_deep", writes=1, bytes=16384, path_depth=1.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import json
import subprocess
sys.path.append('storage/shared')

from meta.sas.tools.shallow_cpu_ops import time_task, shallow_consolidated_write, prepare_shallow_beacon

# Time post-deep shallow consolidated write with 16KB
op_cost_ms = time_task(lambda: shallow_consolidated_write(size_bytes=16384))

# Prepare and emit beacon
beacon = prepare_shallow_beacon('Zephyr V', 'XL:shallow_post_deep', op_cost_ms, writes=1, bytes=16384, path_depth=1)
print(json.dumps(beacon))

# Append via helper
subprocess.call([
    'python',
    'storage/shared/meta/sas/tools/emit_cps_v4_beacon.py',
    'Zephyr V',
    'CPS_v4:XL_shallow_post_deep',
    str(op_cost_ms),
    'op_cost_ms',
    '1.0'
])
